aub_upgrade_chain_palace_of_ctesiphon_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = palace_of_ctesiphon_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_palace_of_ctesiphon_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = 2000 }
		}
		remove_building = palace_of_ctesiphon_01
		scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
		add_special_building = palace_of_ctesiphon_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = palace_of_ctesiphon_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = 2000 }
		}
		else = {
			scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
			add_special_building = palace_of_ctesiphon_01
		}
	}
}

			aub_pay_gold_prestige_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = tribal_building_tier_2_cost PRESTIGE = expensive_building_tier_2_cost }
		}
	}
}

			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_2_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = qanats_02
			aub_can_upgrade_to_qanats_03_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = qanats_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = qanats_03 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_3_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = qanats_03
			aub_can_upgrade_to_qanats_04_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = qanats_03
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = qanats_04 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = qanats_04
			aub_can_upgrade_to_qanats_05_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = qanats_04
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = qanats_05 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_5_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = qanats_05
			aub_can_upgrade_to_qanats_06_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_6_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = qanats_05
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = qanats_06 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_6_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = qanats_06
			aub_can_upgrade_to_qanats_07_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_7_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = qanats_06
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = qanats_07 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_7_cost }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = qanats_07
			aub_can_upgrade_to_qanats_08_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_8_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = qanats_07
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = qanats_08 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = normal_building_tier_8_cost }
		}
	}
}
